title: One hundred rounds against the dephased Mellin obstruction
question: Can established positivity, symmetry, dephasing, entropy or flow properties bootstrap finitely many Mellin rungs to the next rung?

protocol.target: derive A_(j+1)<infinity from A_1,...,A_j and one established structural mechanism

verdict.conclusion: All one hundred finite-bootstrap attempts fail for the same exact reason.  For every finite rung J there is a reflected positive state Q_eta with 1/[2(J+1)]<eta<1/(2J).  It satisfies A_1 through A_J and all ten established structural properties, while A_(J+1) diverges.  Therefore no finite combination of those properties can inductively cross the next Mellin boundary.  A successful route must add genuinely arithmetic same-xi information that rules out the separator state; all screened standard candidates are either insufficient, finite-height only or already RH-equivalent.

generalNoGoTheorem.statement: for every J>=1, choose eta_J in (1/[2(J+1)],1/(2J)); then Q_eta_J=[p_eta_J+p_-eta_J]/2 has finite A_j for every j<=J and divergent A_(J+1)
generalNoGoTheorem.proof: the j-th slow-branch exponent is 1+1/j-2eta; convergence is equivalent to 2eta<1/j
generalNoGoTheorem.scope: rules out finite bootstrap from the retained abstract structural properties; does not rule out a new arithmetic identity special to the actual xi divisor

mechanisms.label: positivity of the dephased diagonal
mechanisms.whyRetained: the reflected state is a positive convex mixture

mechanisms.label: trace and probability normalization
mechanisms.whyRetained: both component laws have mass one

mechanisms.label: functional-equation-style horizontal reflection
mechanisms.whyRetained: the state contains eta and -eta with equal weight

mechanisms.label: logarithmic CPTP dephasing
mechanisms.whyRetained: each component is the exact diagonal of a dephased rank-one feature

mechanisms.label: finite relative entropy to p_0
mechanisms.whyRetained: eta is strictly below one half, so the relevant logarithmic von-Mangoldt moments converge

mechanisms.label: all fixed logarithmic moments
mechanisms.whyRetained: every sum of Lambda(n)n^(-2+2eta)(log n)^k converges for fixed k

mechanisms.label: the componentwise Fisher natural-gradient flow
mechanisms.whyRetained: p_eta belongs to the same exponential family with eta-dot=-eta

mechanisms.label: invariance under common unit logarithmic phases
mechanisms.whyRetained: unit phases do not change either probability diagonal

mechanisms.label: positive trace-class feature density
mechanisms.whyRetained: the mixture is a convex sum of rank-one trace-one states

mechanisms.label: strict entropy and moment convexity
mechanisms.whyRetained: the von-Mangoldt exponential family has positive Fisher variance away from degeneracy
